name: Buffet Boss
description:
Have you always wanted to own a buffet restaurant?

Everyone must start from the bottom, but by working hard you can get promoted and raise to the top of the food chain. Being the boss is all fun and games. Hire people to do the job and expand your restaurant chain.

Features easy controls and relaxing gameplay.

Have fun!
